quest.title: Bygones Times Like Dust Passing
quest.description: Only two materials left to find. Time to ask around at the worksite.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x625, Mora x22575, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

chapter.title: The Crane Returns on the Wind

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Qiqi! What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Seaside. Dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Qiqi
dialogues.text: Qiqi is helping. With the evacuation.

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: Yes. Ningguang said there's something bad in the sea.

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: So she sent Qiqi, to evacuate everyone.

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: But, no one will listen to Qiqi. So instead, Qiqi is guarding this place.

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: If danger comes, Qiqi will protect everyone.

response.speaker: Qiqi
response.text: Don't go near the sea. It's too dangerous.

talks.objective: Go to the worksite to ask around for news

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Look, look, {NICKNAME}! The Jade Chamber is floating into the sky!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But it seems to be tied down by something...

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: That's because it's not finished.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Baiwen! And hey Beidou! And hey, um... person Paimon doesn't know...

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Given the enormous scale of the Jade Chamber, we split the construction work into two phases to make sure the structure remains balanced.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Before we find some suitable Plaustrite, we build the Jade Chamber's keel at ground level.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Once the Plaustrite is ready, we place it into the keel and let the partially-constructed Jade Chamber rise up to the height of the surrounding mountain peaks.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: The remainder of the construction work is then carried out at that altitude. Once everything is ready, we release the iron tethers and allow the Jade Chamber to rise to its target altitude.

dialogues.speaker: Changgui
dialogues.text: Miss Baiwen, we've brought some new materials to submit—

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: One moment. I'll be right there.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: The construction work has only been able to progress this rapidly thanks to the Plaustrite provided by you. Lady Ningguang is most grateful and looks forward to seeing more of your work.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Wow! Can't believe you sourced the Plaustrite so quickly — it's the key piece of the puzzle. Looks like you beat us to the punch.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Beidou... you're joining the Jade Chamber contest too?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Sure am. I happened to get my hands on a chunk of Sunset Vermillionite on a voyage a while back, so I figured I'd bring it over.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, so even though it's rare, we're not the only ones who managed to get hold of it...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Oh, I've got some introductions to do: This is the renowned Ms. Yun, or Yun Jin, probably the most famous figure in the Liyue opera scene.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Greetings.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: These two are Paimon and the Traveler, both good buddies of mine, and this is... Um, sorry, I'm not sure we've met...

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Shenhe. I am their... friend.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Hahaha... Good to meet ya! A friend of a friend is my friend too — or as I like to say, a mate of a crewmate is part of the crew!

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Ms. Yun is also here for the contest. Turned out she needed to borrow a boat, so we came together.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: It's an honor to finally meet you both. I've heard much about you. Ms. Shenhe, though we are only meeting for the first time, I have a feeling that we will get along very well indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: To be honest with you all, I am in great need of this opportunity to ask Lady Ningguang a question. That's why I joined the contest. Thanks to my father's connections, I was able to acquire a specimen of the Plaustrite required. Fortunately, it was approved for submission, despite being a little on the diminutive side.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow... So it looks like the three of us are competitors now!

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Excuse me for prying, Ms. Shenhe, but... are you competing as well?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: #No. I don't have any questions for Ningguang. I just wanted to help {NICKNAME} win.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: In that case... I have a proposal to make.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Lady Ningguang said that the first three contestants to procure all three materials will be awarded the chance to ask a question. Well, there are three teams here. We can split the prize between us.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Instead of competing against each other, we could work together to secure the top three places between us. What do you think?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds great! But how does that change things, exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Haha... I think I see where you're going with this, Ms. Yun.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: The Plaustrite was the most difficult item to source by a long shot. Luckily, all three of us managed to get our hands on it. The two remaining items aren't quite so rare, so as long as one of us finds a way to source it, the other two can hop on the bandwagon.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: How'd I do? Is that what you had in mind?

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Precisely.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Huh. Interesting approach.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Okay then! Alright, I'll go first. I have some leads on these "Wonder Cores."

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: From what I've heard, the core itself is really not that difficult to make. The hard part is getting hold of the ore used as raw materials. I'm gonna head back to the ship and ask Suling if he's heard of them, you guys—

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: #We will head into town and seek advice from Master Zhang of Hanfeng's Ironmongers. Thoughts, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Wonderful. We'll split into teams then, and whoever makes progress first brings all of us a step closer to victory.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: I'm gonna take off — see you later!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay. Let's go.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: By the way, what question are you gonna ask Ningguang, Yun Jin?

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: I'm looking for a venue to host the performance of our new opera. Lady Ningguang has excellent judgment, so I would like to hear her opinion.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa... What's the opera called? Paimon wants to go see it!

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: The opera is a labor of love by my father. He wrote it based on a popular urban legend about an evil spirit and an adeptus.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: It's called "The Divine Damsel of Devastation."

choices.text: You can trust Master Zhang's smithing skills.

talks.objective: Ask Master Zhang about Wonder Cores

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: Hmm? Ah, hello. Are you here for something off-the-shelf? Or do you need something forged?

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Excuse me, Master Zhang, we were wondering if you'd heard of something called a "Wonder Core."

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: Of course I have. Sorry, um... who's asking?

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: My name is Yun Jin. Perhaps you don't know me, but I believe that you've forged some weaponry for my father in the past, for stage use.

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: Yun Jin? Stage use? ...Oh! So... you must be Ms. Yun?

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: Ahem, sorry, my brain's finally caught up! It's not used to doing much beyond bashing a hammer all day... Everyone's heard of you, Ms. Yun! Even folks who don't make it to the opera all that often, like myself.

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: So. You're here to ask about Wonder Cores, huh? As it happens, I do know how to make them. Matter of fact, I made some for Lady Ningguang back when she was building the original Jade Chamber.

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: The types of ore needed to make Wonder Cores are a little hard to come by. Lady Ningguang supplied them herself last time — I don't suppose you've brought any yourselves?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No... We were gonna ask you what kinds of ore we need!

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: Sure. Well, you'll need two kinds: Starsplinter Iron and Subrosium.

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: If I remember correctly, Lady Ningguang sourced her Starsplinter Iron from the Mt. Tianheng area. They say it <color=#00E1FFFF>resonates with Visions.</color>

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: It could take some work, but if you stick with it, you'll find some eventually. As for the Subrosium, though... that's trickier. It's all but unheard of on the market...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then... where do we start?

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: Uh... I'm really not sure, sorry. What I've heard is that the people around Mt. Tianheng have some sort of magic trick that can pinpoint the location of the stuff.

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: Of course, it's probably just hearsay. If you want my advice, start by looking for Starsplinter Iron around Mt. Tianheng, and if you run into any locals, ask them a few questions about Subrosium.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Mt. Tianheng...

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Interestingly enough, the story of "The Divine Damsel of Devastation" also takes place on that mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: I hear the view there is quite spectacular. A favorite destination of the adepti, in fact.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Perhaps it can give me some inspiration. Let's not delay, we should head straight there.

talks.objective: Go to the southwestern side of Mt. Tianheng

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: I came to Mt. Tianheng once with my father as a child. I remember it being such a long climb that I could barely feel my legs by the time we reached the top.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: This is quite a trip down memory lane for me... Look at these majestic towering peaks and the gently flowing streams. It's like setting foot in paradise.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: No wonder the legend of "The Divine Damsel of Devastation" is said to have taken place here. "Adepti wander oft where mortals seldom stride." Indeed, this looks like a place that one might expect to be frequented by adepti.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "The Divine Damsel of Devastation" is your upcoming opera, right? And the story takes place in Mt. Tianheng, huh... Seems like you have a real connection with this place!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's the story about, though?

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: It's... the story of a girl becoming a hero.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Cool, a hero story! They're Paimon's favorite!

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: The legend first arose in this area. It is said that there used to be a prosperous village on the mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: In that village, there was a loving couple who were completely devoted to one another. One day, a terrifying monster appeared.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: The wife was out collecting herbs and was captured by the monster. Her husband was so distraught at the news that it broke his spirit, and drove him to madness.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: The vile and vicious monster told the villagers, "If you want to live, you must sacrifice a child to me!"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What a nasty piece of work! Ugh! Paimon sure hopes this monster gets put in its place!

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: But the monster was so terrible and so strong that all within the village were terrified of it. They had no choice but to give in to the monster's demand.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Just while they were discussing whose child would be given over to the monster, a little girl suddenly stood up and came forward.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No! Don't do it, little girl!

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Unbeknownst to anybody else, she was concealing an exorcist's blade. She approached the monster's lair, feigning fear and trepidation... When she finally arrived, she courageously drew her sword and entered into a fierce struggle with the monster, from which she eventually emerged as the victor.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Her extraordinary abilities drew the attention of the adepti, and they took her as one of their own. Her story became the stuff of legends... But alas, the paths of mortals and adepti seldom cross, and she would never again re-enter the mortal world.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: "And so, destined to grace the mortal realm for but a brief moment, she vanished like a wisp of smoke into thin air." That's how the opera ends.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I really like this story.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: But I personally think that perhaps the little girl was... not as brave as the opera makes her out to be.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: I'm not sure she deserves all the praise she is given.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: I've never considered that before.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Opera is always an interpretation of the events it purports to portray. A certain degree of deviation from the truth is always inevitable.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: When my father wrote the script for this play, I suppose his intention was to inspire his audience with the character of the divine damsel.

response.speaker: Shenhe
response.text: Mm. I think it's a great story. The ideal story.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well... it sure inspired Paimon! Let's go get ourselves some Starsplinter Iron! Yeah!

talks.objective: Use <color=#00E1FFFF>Visions</color> to find the Starsplinter Iron

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, there really is someone here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yun Jin, looks like you were right. Excuse us, Sir! Can we ask you something?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Huh, he didn't seem to catch that, {NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Hello, Sir. We were just passing by and wanted to ask if you happened to know anything about Subrosium.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is he tryna tell us to look for clues in the village...? Well, whatever. Guess we're on our own here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Shenhe, Yun Jin, {NICKNAME}, let's have a look around!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Sorry, you can go ahead without me. I'd like to have a word with this gentleman.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: If that's okay with you... Uncle Mingjun?

dialogues.speaker: Mingjun
dialogues.text: It's... it's...!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Shenhe.

dialogues.speaker: Mingjun
dialogues.text: Shenhe... You're alive? The rumors were true? So, all these years...

dialogues.speaker: Mingjun
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, I don't know how to find Subrosium. But I think you can find some information in the village...

dialogues.speaker: Mingjun
dialogues.text: This place is deserted now. No one ever comes here. So you can rummage around all you want.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? You know this guy, Shenhe?

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Thank you, kind sir. We'll go and take a look around.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Don't worry. Mingjun has no ill intention towards Ms. Shenhe. She'll be quite safe.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay. Then let's see what we can find in this village.

talks.objective: Ask the old man for information about Subrosium

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: What's this...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe this is the true story of "The Divine Damsel of Devastation."

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: So... Shenhe is the divine damsel?

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Now that I think about it, she does behave rather like an adeptus, and she is about the right age...

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: So that's why I've been getting the strangest feeling whenever I chat with her. I should've noticed it earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: According to this text, the "divine damsel" from the opera was actually the daughter of the loving couple.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: And... she didn't volunteer. She was... sacrificed to the monster. By her own father.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: The truth is even more lamentable than the opera. Now I understand why Shenhe said the girl was not as brave as people think... It wasn't her choice to enter that ghastly situation. She was forced into it.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: It looks like my father may need to make a few revisions to his beloved opera...

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: The remains of a god... an abandoned village... Mt. Tianheng...

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Does this mean that the true story of "The Divine Damsel of Devastation" happened right here, in this village?

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: The time frame certainly matches, so it seems we're in the right area. Let's keep looking around.

dialogues.speaker: Changfeng
dialogues.text: The Jade Chamber belongs in the sky amongst the clouds!

talks.objective: Search for records left behind in the village

dialogues.speaker: Anshun
dialogues.text: I heard that Lady Keqing has gone to Guyun Stone Forest.

talks.objective: Continue searching for records concerning ore

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So basically, we need to go to the <color=#00E1FFFF>middle of the lake</color> south of Mt. Tianheng at <color=#00E1FFFF>dusk</color>, and we'll find us some Subrosium.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go back and tell Shenhe the news.

dialogues.speaker: Mingjun
dialogues.text: One year when I was back visiting, I heard a story about a white-haired adeptus from a merchant passing by. I never imagined it was you.

dialogues.speaker: Mingjun
dialogues.text: I was a very close friend of your father's. I could have stopped him from performing the summoning ritual — I had plenty of chances, but... I couldn't bring myself to stand up to him. I just let things happen, let it all escalate, and... Well, we all know how that story ended.

dialogues.speaker: Mingjun
dialogues.text: I bring flowers back here every year, and each time I wish I had a chance to apologize to you.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Apologize for what? If you'd stopped him, he'd only have found another way.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: There is nothing he wouldn't have done for his true love. Nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Mingjun
dialogues.text: Do you still... hate him?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I don't know what I feel. I'm told my fate is to bear the curse of calamity, so my master bound my soul with red ropes to curb my aggression. But it also dampened my emotions, making me dispassionate like the adepti.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: So if you ask me how I feel about the past, if I hate my father or not... The truth is, I feel nothing at all.

dialogues.speaker: Mingjun
dialogues.text: It must have been so tough for you all these years...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shenhe, we're back!

dialogues.speaker: Mingjun
dialogues.text: Oh, then I will leave you all in peace. Shenhe, it brings me some solace knowing that you are okay.

dialogues.speaker: Mingjun
dialogues.text: I'll tell you more about the old times next time we meet.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Thanks, mister! We found some info in the end!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shenhe, look! This tells us how to find Subrosium. All we gotta do is go to the middle of that lake!

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Hm? Let's go then.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Ms. Shenhe, there's something I'd like to talk to you about.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Just now, in the village, we found your father's diary... It turns out that many of the details in "The Divine Damsel of Devastation" are not true to the facts. So I'd like to change them.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Why?

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: I know I say that opera always deviates from the truth, but now that the main character is standing right here in front of me, I cannot simply dismiss your lived experience in favor of my father's fiction.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: It's okay. I like your version.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: My master once said that the day I learn how to use my strength for the good of others is the day that I can truly become part of human society.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: So I hope that one day, I might be brave enough to stand up and protect others, just like the girl in the opera.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: But I've never thought this way before and I wonder whether I will continue to think in this way.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Don't worry. I believe you will.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: In fact, I think maybe you've already started to become the person you aspire to be. You just haven't had the opportunity to see it for yourself yet.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shenhe, Yun Jin, cut the chit-chat! Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We can't let someone else beat us to it!

talks.objective: Go to the middle of the lake

dialogues.speaker: Liang
dialogues.text: I heard a good few of my comrades have been sent over to Guyun Stone Forest. I sure hope they'll be safe out there...

dialogues.speaker: Anshun
dialogues.text: The fact we were able to complete the construction work on schedule is a testament to everyone's hard work.

talks.objective: Give the two types of ore you found to Master Zhang

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: Goodness...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: S—So, are they okay?

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: This is some top-quality ore you've found. I think I'll get a good end product out of these.

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: Guess now it's my time to shine...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Hey everyone. How's the A-Team doing?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: I ran into a bit of a brick wall on my end. Suling's never seen a Wonder Core before, and says it'd take a lot of research for him to get up to speed...

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: Leave the Wonder Cores to me. I'll work on them while you go about your business.

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: Don't worry, it won't take me too long.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Much obliged, Master Zhang. We should look into the Adepti Sigils next, but where should we find items relating to the adepti?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I'll sort that out.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Oh? You got this then?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Yes. I have been training with the adepti for years. I know a thing or two about making sigils.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: When we first met, I told you I came for the Jade Chamber, not the contest.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: In fact, I came specifically to deliver Adepti Sigils. Master heard that Ningguang was planning to rebuild the Jade Chamber, so she sent me to deliver some Adepti Sigils to her.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Master also said she hoped that I can take this opportunity to rejoin human society. But now that I'm here, I wonder if I've been removed from the world for too long. There's so much basic knowledge that I lack.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Maybe it won't work for me to stay here after all. But either way, I'm very glad to have met you, and I'll take care of those Adepti Sigils.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Without knowing the ins and outs of your situation, I can't say whether you should stay or not.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: But now that our paths have crossed, we'll always have a connection. So if you're ever feeling down, come find me on my ship. There'll be a drink waiting for ya.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: So... Master Zhang, I'll need to use your facilities to make the sigils.

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: Fine by me, I'm actually curious to see how the adepti arts work. Maybe I'll learn something.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Master Zhang and Shenhe start making the Wonder Cores and the Adepti Sigils.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Phew...

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: The sigils are ready. Though they are in some respects inferior to my master's, I can assure you there will be no quality issues.

dialogues.speaker: Master Zhang
dialogues.text: I've finished forging the things you asked for too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great! Let's go submit them before someone else gets there ahead of us!

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Ah, Traveler, Paimon. I wasn't expecting to run into you out here at Guyun.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: What brings you here? You'll have to make it quick, I'm afraid, I really can't afford to chat for too long.

choices.text: What are you doing out here?

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: As you can see, we're working on a construction project.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Personally, I consider this project to be of greater importance than the Jade Chamber rebuild. That's why I'm here to supervise.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: I just hope we can complete it on schedule...

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: A new type of Guizhong Ballista.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Ningguang commissioned an expert to dismantle and study the Guizhong Ballista, and design an improved version based on the original.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: This design is a step down from the adepti's original Guizhong Ballista in terms of firing speed and power, but the good thing about it is that it can be mass-produced.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: It's also considerably easier to assemble and disassemble. This will allow for flexible deployment, whatever the location.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: I'm confident it will prove very useful in dealing with future crises.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: So it seems that Shenhe's father thought he was summoning a benevolent deity using a magic incantation, but in fact he summoned an evil god's remains, which took the form of a monster.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: His obsessive yearning for his deceased wife led to a terrible tragedy, the villagers moved away in fear without ever learning the truth... and now this place is deserted.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Still, I do wonder what the connection is between Shenhe and Mingjun.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I came back here once before, a few years ago. Alone. I hid it from Master at the time.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: It was deserted then, too, except for a few low-life bandits. Everyone and everything I remembered was long gone. But as people were passing by, they stopped to admire me... they praised me, telling me I gave off the aura of an adeptus.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I tried explaining to them that I wasn't an adeptus, just an ordinary person who came from this village. But no one believed me.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: When I saw how run-down all these houses were, I felt at a loss. It was like I took a look at the world and, on the surface, it looked like a vast realm with so many places I could go. Then I looked a little closer. And there was nowhere for me to go at all.

dialogues.speaker: Mingjun
dialogues.text: Suddenly, so much time has gone by, and everything has changed.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Last time I visited, I felt so upset. But today... I don't know why, but it feels different.

dialogues.speaker: Mingjun
dialogues.text: It is easy for your mind to run wild when you are alone. But this time, you are with your friends, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Yes, my... my friends.

dialogues.speaker: Leming
dialogues.text: The next step is to build the pavilions on the upper layer while we wait for the Wonder Cores and the Adepti Sigils.

dialogues.speaker: Lizheng
dialogues.text: The basic structure is beginning to take shape, but there is still a lot of work to do... Get back to it.

dialogues.speaker: Siqin
dialogues.text: We're halfway there. I must keep my wits about me and continue to ensure the safety of the site for the remainder of the project!

dialogues.speaker: Changfeng
dialogues.text: The Jade Chamber looks magnificent...

dialogues.speaker: Leming
dialogues.text: The construction work on the Jade Chamber is now complete. Once we install the Wonder Cores and the Adepti Sigils, we can let it rise to altitude.

dialogues.speaker: Lizheng
dialogues.text: I don't know about anyone else, but this has been a challenging project for me... Let's get a drink after work.

dialogues.speaker: Siqin
dialogues.text: I can't wait to see the Jade Chamber ascend!

dialogues.speaker: Liang
dialogues.text: Finally, we can relax a little. It's been quite stressful recently with so many people flocking here.

dialogues.speaker: Liang
dialogues.text: Fortunately, the construction here has gone off without a hitch. I can only hope the same is true for my comrades at Guyun Stone Forest.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: What brings you here?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Have they found a solution to the danger in the sea?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What danger in the sea?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Ningguang didn't tell you?

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Something has happened in Guyun Stone Forest. According to the contract, as an adeptus, I should not get involved for now.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: But these things can be unpredictable. I have a contingency plan of my own.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Xiao, what do you...

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: Only a single mountain lies between here and Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Xiao
dialogues.text: If things get out of control, I will defend this place myself.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Look, look, {NICKNAME}! The Jade Chamber is floating into the sky!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But it seems to be tied down by something...

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: That's because it's not finished.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Baiwen! And hey, um... people Paimon doesn't know..

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Given the enormous scale of the Jade Chamber, we split the construction work into two phases to make sure the structure remains balanced.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Before we find some suitable Plaustrite, we build the Jade Chamber's keel at ground level.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: Once the Plaustrite is ready, we place it into the keel and let the partially-constructed Jade Chamber rise up to the height of the surrounding mountain peaks.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: The remainder of the construction work is then carried out at that altitude. Once everything is ready, we release the iron tethers and allow the Jade Chamber to rise to its target altitude.

dialogues.speaker: Changgui
dialogues.text: Miss Baiwen, we've brought some new materials to submit—

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: One moment. I'll be right there.

dialogues.speaker: Baiwen
dialogues.text: The construction work has only been able to progress this rapidly thanks to the Plaustrite provided by you. Lady Ningguang is most grateful and looks forward to seeing more of your work.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Wow! Can't believe you sourced the Plaustrite so quickly — it's the key piece of the puzzle. Looks like you beat us to the punch.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Wait, I know you. You're the one who fought against the Fatui and Osial, right? Sure enough, your reputation precedes you.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Pleasure to meet you, I'm Beidou, Captain of The Crux.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Beidou... are you here to join the Jade Chamber contest too?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Sure am. I happened to get my hands on a chunk of Sunset Vermillionite on a voyage a while back, so I figured I'd bring it over.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, so even though it's rare, we're not the only ones who managed to get hold of it...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Oh, I've got some introductions to do: This is the renowned Ms. Yun, or Yun Jin, probably the most famous figure in the Liyue opera scene.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Greetings.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: #These two are Paimon and {NICKNAME}, I'm sure you've heard of them before. And this is... um, sorry, I'm not sure we've met.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Shenhe. I am their... friend.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Hahaha... Good to meet ya! Well, from today on, I guess all of us are friends!

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Ms. Yun is also here for the contest. Turned out she needed to borrow a boat, so we came together.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: It's an honor to finally meet you both. I've heard much about you. Ms. Shenhe, though we are only meeting for the first time, I have a feeling that we will get along very well indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: To be honest with you all, I am in great need of this opportunity to ask Lady Ningguang a question. That's why I joined the contest. Thanks to my father's connections, I was able to acquire a specimen of the Plaustrite required. Fortunately, it was approved for submission, despite being a little on the diminutive side.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow... So it looks like the three of us are competitors now!

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Excuse me for prying, Ms. Shenhe, but... are you competing as well?

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: #No. I don't have any questions for Ningguang. I just wanted to help {NICKNAME} win.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: In that case... I have a proposal to make.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Lady Ningguang said that the first three contestants to procure all three materials will be awarded the chance to ask a question. Well, there are three teams here. We can split the prize between us.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Instead of competing against each other, we could work together to secure the top three places between us. What do you think?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds great! But how does that change things, exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Haha... I think I see where you're going with this, Ms. Yun.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: The Plaustrite was the most difficult item to source by a long shot. Luckily, all three of us managed to get our hands on it. The two remaining items aren't quite so rare, so as long as one of us finds a way to source it, the other two can hop on the bandwagon.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: How'd I do? Is that what you had in mind?

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Precisely.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: Huh. Interesting approach.

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Okay then! Alright, I'll go first. I have some leads on these "Wonder Cores."

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: From what I've heard, the core itself is really not that difficult to make. The hard part is getting hold of the ore used as raw materials. I'm gonna head back to the ship and ask Suling if he's heard of them, you guys—

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: #We will head into town and seek advice from Master Zhang of Hanfeng's Ironmongers. Thoughts, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: Wonderful. We'll split into teams then, and whoever makes progress first brings all of us a step closer to victory.

response.speaker: Beidou
response.text: I'm gonna take off — see you later!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay. Let's go.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: By the way, what question are you gonna ask Ningguang, Yun Jin?

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: I'm looking for a venue to host the performance of our new opera. Lady Ningguang has excellent judgment, so I would like to hear her opinion.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa... What's the opera called? Paimon wants to go see it!

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: The opera is a labor of love by my father. He wrote it based on a popular urban legend about an evil spirit and an adeptus.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: It's called "The Divine Damsel of Devastation."

choices.text: You can trust Master Zhang's smithing skills.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: By the way, what question are you gonna ask Ningguang, Yun Jin?

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: I'm looking for a venue to host the performance of our new opera. Ningguang has excellent judgment, so I would like to hear her opinion.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... What's the opera called? Paimon wants to go see it!

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: The opera is a labor of love by my father. He wrote it's a story about an evil spirit and an adeptus.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: It's called "The Divine Damsel of Devastation."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This should be enough Starsplinter Iron. Now we just need to find that "Subrosium"...

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: I think I saw a village on our way here.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Master Zhang said we should ask the locals for help. Why don't we try there?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, we've looked everywhere but still no mention of Subrosium.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's have a look over there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's everything we need! Let's head back and report in!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's curious if Beidou's made any progress...

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: The zombie called Qiqi is right. A great wrath brews in the sea.

dialogues.speaker: Shenhe
dialogues.text: I don't know where this wrath comes from. So let's keep our distance for the time being.
